correctness.rationale: The unique 00000 edge anchors rotation classes; every 32-edge Euler circuit in the B(2,4) graph maps to one binary order-five de Bruijn cycle. Independent Eulerian backtracking with no code copied from the repository generated exactly 2048 distinct cycles, each with all 32 length-five cyclic factors. Balance makes circular discrepancy max(cyclic prefix)-min(cyclic prefix). Computing it exhaustively yielded counts (5,224),(6,688),(7,912),(8,224), all summing to 2048. Canonical cyclic rotations of complement and reversal images partition the 224 minima into exactly 52 size-four and eight size-two orbits. Since the graph covers all edge-use possibilities and fixes the unique distinguished edge, this is complete finite exhaustion, not an inference from samples.
